title: crucifera irio
intro: Crucifera irio, commonly known as Rocket or Garden Rocket, is a leafy green annual plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Crucifera irio include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to its ability to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Crucifera irio include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable addition to a healthy diet.
